title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover hysteresis and backoff ordering
author: Priya Shah
description: Production incident on 2025-02-17 revealed SLO-enforcer could incorrectly order regional backoff/hysteresis updates under high fan-out which caused cascading regional failovers and request thrashing. This hotfix implements a deterministic ordering and idempotent backoff update path, tightens hysteresis window evaluation to use monotonic timestamps, and adds a short-circuit to avoid applying outdated state from delayed replicas. The change bundle includes a fix to leader election ordering in the enforcer controller, an idempotency key for backoff updates, additional unit/integration tests that reproduce the race, and a conservative rollout plan. The risk is low and no schema or API changes are introduced. Linear ENG-1429 tracks the root-cause and ENG-1430 tracks the rollout verification steps. SUP-3321 is the customer-facing ticket correlated to the incident. Deployment notes: canary 10% traffic to region-eu for 30 minutes, monitor SLO and queue-depth metrics, then gradual 50% -> 100% if stable; rollback plan is built-in via feature-flag to revert ordering semantics.

review_comments: Miguel Torres: This looks sensible, I was able to reproduce the race with the new test. Two nits inline: prefer explicit pb.Time.UnixNano usage and add comment on the idempotency key format.
Priya Shah: Thanks Miguel, addressed both nits in c4d1f2a and updated comments. Idempotency key uses <region>-<leaderTS>-<seq> pattern now which is documented in backoff_store.go.
Ava Chen: Concern about perf overhead of serializing apply in hot path, can we limit to cross-region updates only?

Priya Shah: Good point, implemented selective serialization: local-region immediate applies remain unchanged; only cross-region backoff updates are ordered. See leader_election.go update. Added benchmark note.
Samir Patel: CI flaked on integration on first run, reran and all green. Approving after CI green.
Ava Chen: Approved after verifying dashboard panels report expected hysteresis metrics in staging.
release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover by fixing ordering of backoff/hysteresis updates and adding idempotency. Mitigates cascading regional failovers under high fan-out. Deploy behind feature flag for gradual rollout.
notes_deployment: Canary deployed to region-eu at 10% for 30m then 50% for 30m then 100% on 2025-02-20; monitored SLO, latency P95, queue-depth, and backoff events. No regressions observed. Feature flag left enabled for rollout to remaining regions.
rollback_plan: Feature flag off reverts ordering semantics; orchestration includes automated rollback if SLO error budget burn > 1% in 15m window; runbook SUP-3321 updated with steps.
